en.headline: Man dies after collapsing at Kwai Fong minibus stop
en.dek: Rescuers performed cardiopulmonary resuscitation on the man who fell unconscious near New Town Plaza before he was taken to Yan Chai Hospital, where he was certified dead.
body: A man collapsed and later died at a minibus stop outside New Town Plaza in Kwai Fong on Thursday evening, police said.

Reports indicated the man fell unconscious at about 7.18pm. Rescuers knelt on the pavement and took turns performing cardiopulmonary resuscitation before placing him on a stretcher and taking him by ambulance to Yan Chai Hospital.
He was certified dead after arrival at the hospital. Police are investigating the circumstances of the collapse.
The incident occurred at a busy minibus stand serving the shopping centre and surrounding area. No other injuries were reported.

zh.headline: 葵芳新都會廣場小巴站男子暈倒送院後不治
zh.dek: 救援人員在行人路邊輪流為事主進行心外壓，其後送往仁濟醫院，最終證實不治。
body: 警方表示，周四晚上葵芳新都會廣場對開小巴站有一名男子暈倒，其後不治。
據報事主於晚上約7時18分陷入昏迷。救援人員跪地輪流為他進行心外壓，其後戴上氧氣罩，抬上擔架床，由救護車送往仁濟醫院。
事主送抵醫院後證實不治。警方正調查事主暈倒原因。
事件發生在繁忙的小巴站頭，附近沒有其他受傷報告。
